items.title: James Hunter interviewed by Monk Rowe, Boston, Massachusetts, July 25, 2018
items.q: Yeah, ah well, I’m a Corbyn man you know. I want him in.

ctx.x: Yeah I mean but we’ve got — our leader at home is this vacuous follower who basically will do anything to latch on to power including falling in with, you know, sort of extreme right wing parties like the DUP you know. That’s how she got her false majority to stay in power after a hung Parliament. I mean she called a what do you call it, she called a general election thinking she was going to get a huge mandate and she made a cut of it. Yeah, ah well, I’m a Corbyn man you know. I want him in. Because people say…
Well some things are sort of the same across the pond. Who are your musical heroes?
